title: Gold vs Ethereum Ratio in Downtrend
description: Here we have the ratio chart of gold over Ethereum= When this ratio moves down, that tells me Ethereum is outperforming gold. On the monthly chart presented, I see the ratio went down from 2017 to 2022. In other words there was a 5 year bull cycle where Ethereum outperformed gold. Then coincidentally from 2022-2027 (the last 5 years) the ratio moved upwards and gold outperformed Ethereum. In other words, there was a 5 year bull cycle where gold outperformed Ethereum after Ethereum lead 5 years prior. The forecast from here is for the downtrend to continue based on the rejection of the 200 monthly EMA and a possible 5 year cycle theory. Next year may mark a major shift in sentiment for Ethereum to outperform over gold by 2x. These are my personal thoughts and only my opinion. My opinions are not investment advice. Consider these thoughts and comment what you think.

title: Thor Explorations (TSXV:THX)
description: Thor Explorations is a West African gold producer whose operations are centered on the Segilola Gold Project in Nigeria. The company’s core identity is that of a producer rather than a pure explorer: Segilola is the asset that anchors the business and drives its revenue generation. Alongside its gold production focus, Thor Explorations also has additional silver and lithium exploration interests, which broaden its overall resource base and add exploration optionality beyond the flagship gold project. In terms of operations, the business generates its revenue primarily from the Segilola Mine Project, which produced about $331 million. That revenue concentration is important because it means the company’s financial performance is closely tied to the performance of a single producing asset. At the same time, the fact that Segilola is already in production is a defining characteristic of the investment case: Thor Explorations is not relying solely on future development timelines or resource estimates to justify its value. The broader boundaries remain approximately $750–$752 below and $783–$784 above. Despite the dramatic moves between them, that range has largely remained intact. The bulls still have an opportunity to defend support. The bears have an opportunity to turn an established floor into resistance.
